title: 25 States Brought Cursive Back As Literacy Collapsed
hook: 25 states brought cursive back after young readers lost the skill.
closing: Without cursive literacy, family letters and historical records become harder to read.
question: Did you learn cursive?

segments.say: Cursive instruction now reaches 25 states. Schools are restoring a skill many students lost.
About 67 percent of young Americans cannot read cursive. Handwritten letters can look like code.
Roughly 80 percent of National Archives holdings use cursive. Losing the skill locks away history.
